note: These are fully authored companion candidates. They are not recruited automatically. Recruitment will be tied to each NPC's personal urgent quest, and the final party roster remains a player decision.

candidates.name: Elder Varen
candidates.backstory: Varen has spent decades protecting Ashenvale's old records and knows that the forest contains evidence of powers older than the current kingdoms.
candidates.motivation: Protect Ashenvale and prevent the Bloodglass records from falling into the wrong hands.
candidates.recruitmentCondition: Complete the urgent crisis connected to his protection of Ashenvale. He joins only after Shadow proves the forest and its people can be trusted to him.

candidates.name: Lyra Vey

personality.flaw: Will risk herself to answer an unanswered question.

candidates.backstory: Lyra disappeared while investigating a connection between ancient bloodline records and the sealed Bloodglass Sanctum.
candidates.motivation: Recover her research and discover what the Bloodglass records reveal about awakened bloodlines.
candidates.recruitmentCondition: Rescue Lyra and recover enough of her research that she believes Shadow is an ally rather than another person seeking the Bloodglass secrets.

candidates.name: Warden Marek

personality.flaw: Distrusts outsiders until they prove themselves.

candidates.backstory: Marek has guarded the forest trails for years and has recently seen creatures behaving strangely around the Hollowroot Path.
candidates.motivation: Protect the people under his watch and determine what is drawing dangerous creatures into the forest.
candidates.recruitmentCondition: Complete Marek's urgent trail investigation and resolve the immediate threat to the people he protects.

candidates.name: Kora Ironhand

personality.flaw: Refuses to abandon a debt or unfinished job.

candidates.backstory: Kora maintains the surviving forge traditions around Blackspire and has spent years piecing together why the keep was sealed.
candidates.motivation: Protect her forge and uncover the truth behind the Blackspire archive.
candidates.recruitmentCondition: Help Kora resolve the immediate danger surrounding Blackspire's sealed archive and earn her respect through action.

candidates.name: Keeper Serah

personality.flaw: Finds trust difficult even when someone has earned it.

candidates.backstory: Serah is the last known keeper of the Bloodglass Sanctum and has guarded its entrance without knowing whether the outside world is ready for what lies within.
candidates.motivation: Prevent the sanctum's knowledge from being abused while deciding whether the Bloodlands need to know its history.
candidates.recruitmentCondition: Help Serah survive the sanctum crisis and demonstrate that Shadow will respect the responsibility attached to its secrets.
